# MALDI-MSI data preparation 

## Software requirments 

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(scater)
library(BiocParallel)
library(Cardinal)
```

```{r}
mse_1 <- readMSIData("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/raw/ztma_20_rcc_no_normalized_complete_spectrum.imzML", as = "MSImagingExperiment")
mse_2 <- readMSIData("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/raw/ztma_224_rcc_no_normalized_complete_spectrum.imzML", as = "MSImagingExperiment")

mse_1

```


```{r}
# Spectra data
```

## 2. Preprocessing 

### Basic 

```{r}
# Remove z-axis (always 1)
coord(mse_1) <- coord(mse_1)[ , c("x", "y")]
coord(mse_2) <- coord(mse_2)[ , c("x", "y")]
```

### Segmentation 

TMA 20 

```{r}
## TMA20 

library(igraph)

df <- pData(mse_1)

# Build a lookup for faster neighbor search
key <- paste(df$x, df$y, sep = "_")
idx_lookup <- match(key, key)

# For each pixel, find its 4-neighbors (up/down/left/right)
neighbors <- function(i) {
  x <- df$x[i]
  y <- df$y[i]
  nbrs <- paste(
    c(x+1, x-1, x,   x),
    c(y,   y,   y+1, y-1),
    sep = "_"
  )
  match(nbrs, key)
}

# Build edges between each pixel and its neighbors
edges <- 
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    nbs <- neighbors(i)
    nbs <- nbs[!is.na(nbs)]
    if (length(nbs))
      rbind(rep(i, length(nbs)), nbs)
  })

edges <- do.call(cbind, edges)

# Create graph
g <- graph_from_edgelist(t(edges), directed = FALSE)

# Connected component IDs
comp <- components(g)$membership

# Back to the MSIexperiment object:
pData(mse_1)$object_id <- as.character(comp)

# Visualize
image(mse_1, "object_id")
```




```{r}
# Filter segmented objects based on size 
size_objects <- pData(mse_1) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(object_id) %>% dplyr::count()

size_objects <- size_objects %>% mutate(check = ifelse(n < 80 | n > 220, TRUE, FALSE))

# Add to MSI
mse_1$check <- size_objects$check[match(mse_1$object_id, size_objects$object_id)]
image(mse_1, "object_id")

# Filter objects
mse_1_fil <- mse_1[mse_1$check == FALSE]
image(mse_1_fil, "object_id")
```


```{r}
# Export segmentation image for annotation
plot <- pData(mse_1_fil) %>% as.data.frame

centroids <- plot %>% 
  group_by(object_id) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y)
  )

pdf("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TMA20_seg_image.pdf", width = 12, height = 5)
ggplot(plot, aes(x, y, fill = factor(object_id))) +
  scale_x_reverse() + 
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(data = centroids, 
            aes(x, y, label = object_id),
            color = "black",
            size = 4) +
  theme_minimal()+
  guides(fill = "none")
dev.off()


anno <- pData(mse_1_fil) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(run, object_id) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames() %>% mutate(object_id = as.numeric(object_id)) %>% arrange(-object_id) %>% mutate(object_id = as.character(object_id))
write_csv(anno, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TMA20_seg_anno.csv")
```


TMA224 

```{r}
## TMA224

library(igraph)

df <- pData(mse_2)

# Build a lookup for faster neighbor search
key <- paste(df$x, df$y, sep = "_")
idx_lookup <- match(key, key)

# For each pixel, find its 4-neighbors (up/down/left/right)
neighbors <- function(i) {
  x <- df$x[i]
  y <- df$y[i]
  nbrs <- paste(
    c(x+1, x-1, x,   x),
    c(y,   y,   y+1, y-1),
    sep = "_"
  )
  match(nbrs, key)
}

# Build edges between each pixel and its neighbors
edges <- 
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    nbs <- neighbors(i)
    nbs <- nbs[!is.na(nbs)]
    if (length(nbs))
      rbind(rep(i, length(nbs)), nbs)
  })

edges <- do.call(cbind, edges)

# Create graph
g <- graph_from_edgelist(t(edges), directed = FALSE)

# Connected component IDs
```

```{r}
# In TMA225 we had some merged cores, which we manually separated in Excel
df <- pData(mse_2)[, c("x", "y", "object_id", "check")] %>% as.data.frame

# Build empty matrix with image size
width  <- max(df$x)
height <- max(df$y)

label_matrix <- matrix(0L, nrow = height, ncol = width)
label_matrix_1 <- matrix(0L, nrow = height, ncol = width)

label_matrix[cbind(df$y, df$x)] <- df$object_id
label_matrix_1[cbind(df$y, df$x)] <- df$check

library(writexl)
write_xlsx(list(sheet1 = as.data.frame(label_matrix), sheet2 = as.data.frame(label_matrix_1)), path = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TMA224_labelmatrix.xlsx")
```

```{r}
label_matrix_edited <- read_xlsx("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TMA224_labelmatrix.xlsx", col_names = as.character(seq(1, ncol(label_matrix))))

height <- nrow(label_matrix_edited)
width  <- ncol(label_matrix_edited)

df_new <- data.frame(
  x = rep(seq_len(width), times = height),
  y = rep(seq_len(height), each = width),
  object_id_new = as.vector(t(label_matrix_edited))
)

df_new$x_y <- paste0(df_new$x, "_", df_new$y)
mse_2$x_y <- paste0(mse_2$x, "_", mse_2$y)
df_new$object_id_old <- mse_2$object_id[match(df_new$x_y, mse_2$x_y)]
df_new <- df_new %>% filter(object_id_new != "0")

# New number mapping in order
ids <- unique(df_new$object_id_new)
num_part <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9].*$", "", ids))
letter_part <- gsub("^[0-9]+", "", ids)
ord <- order(num_part, letter_part)
ids_sorted <- ids[ord]
new_ids <- seq_along(ids_sorted)
new_ids <- setNames(new_ids, ids_sorted)

df_new$object_id_final <- new_ids[match(df_new$object_id_new, names(new_ids))]

# Add to mse object
mse_2$object_id_final <- df_new$object_id_final[match(mse_2$x_y, df_new$x_y)]
mse_2 <- mse_2[!is.na(mse_2$object_id_final)]
```


```{r}
# Filter segmented objects based on size 
size_objects <- pData(mse_2) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(object_id_final) %>% dplyr::count()

size_objects <- size_objects %>% mutate(check_1 = ifelse(n < 80 | n > 220, TRUE, FALSE))

# Add to MSI
mse_2$check_1 <- size_objects$check_1[match(mse_2$object_id_final, size_objects$object_id_final)]
image(mse_2, "check_1")

# Filter objects
mse_2_fil <- mse_2[mse_2$check_1 == FALSE]
image(mse_2_fil, "check_1")
```

```{r}
# Overwrite object id
mse_2_fil$object_id <- as.character(mse_2_fil$object_id_final)
```

#### Add TMA metadata 

```{r}
anno_224 <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TMA224_seg_anno_final.csv")
anno_20 <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TMA20_seg_anno_final.csv")

mse_1_fil$TMA_id <- anno_20$TMA_id[match(mse_1_fil$object_id, anno_20$object_id)]
mse_2_fil$TMA_id <- anno_224$TMA_id[match(mse_2_fil$object_id, anno_224$object_id)]

# Remove cores with no TMA id (control tissues)
mse_1_fil <- mse_1_fil[!is.na(mse_1_fil$TMA_id)]
image(mse_1_fil, "object_id")

mse_2_fil <- mse_2_fil[!is.na(mse_2_fil$TMA_id)]
image(mse_2_fil, "object_id")
```


```{r}
metadata_all <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC_onlyPT.csv")
#metadata_all <- read_csv("/Volumes/G_DQBM_BB_Central$/users/lasmey/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC_onlyPT.csv")
```

```{r}
# Add TMA ID
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(metadata_all$grid,"x",metadata_all$x,"y",metadata_all$y),"NA","")
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(metadata_all$TMA_id, "x","X")
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(metadata_all$TMA_id, "y","Y")
metadata_all[is.na(metadata_all$x),]$TMA_id <- "CX7Y8" #was missing in data
```

```{r}
metadata_all$subtype_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), metadata_all$subtype, "other")
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"
```

```{r}
## Update survival censoring
metadata_all$status_OS <- ifelse(metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

metadata_all$OS_months <- metadata_all$survival_months

## Combine relevant disease progression categories
metadata_all$pT_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(metadata_all$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", metadata_all$pT_simple))

metadata_all$ISUP_simple <- metadata_all$ISUP
metadata_all$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(metadata_all$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", metadata_all$ISUP))
metadata_all$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", metadata_all$lymphocytes)
```


```{r}
# Make sure stage, grade and necrose are encoded as characters
metadata_all$pT_simple <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_all$pT_simple))
metadata_all$pT_combined <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_all$pT_combined))

metadata_all$ISUP_simple <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_all$ISUP_simple))
metadata_all$ISUP_combined <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_all$ISUP_combined))

metadata_all$necrose <- as.character(paste0("NE",metadata_all$necrose))

# Revert NAs
metadata_all$necrose[metadata_all$necrose == "NENA"] <- NA

metadata_all$ISUP_simple[metadata_all$ISUP_simple == "GNA"] <- NA
metadata_all$ISUP_combined[metadata_all$ISUP_combined == "GNA"] <- NA

metadata_all$pT_simple[metadata_all$pT_simple == "TNA"] <- NA
metadata_all$pT_combined[metadata_all$pT_combined == "TNA"] <- NA
```

```{r}
metadata_selected <- metadata_all %>% select(PID, TMA_id, subtype_combined, gender, age, age_bin, type, status_OS, OS_months, pT_simple, pT_combined, ISUP_simple, ISUP_combined, necrose) %>% as.data.frame
```


```{r}
meta_add <- colnames(metadata_selected)[colnames(metadata_selected) %in% c("PID", "subtype_combined", "gender", "age", "age_bin", "status_OS", "OS_months", "pT_simple", "pT_combined", "ISUP_simple", "ISUP_combined", "necrose")]

for (entry in meta_add) {
  pData(mse_1_fil)[[entry]] <- metadata_selected[,entry][match(pData(mse_1_fil)[["TMA_id"]],metadata_selected[,"TMA_id"])]
  
  pData(mse_2_fil)[[entry]] <- metadata_selected[,entry][match(pData(mse_2_fil)[["TMA_id"]],metadata_selected[,"TMA_id"])]
}
```

### Normalization, Recalibration, Smoothing, Peak picking, Peak align

```{r}
mse_1_fil_ccRCC <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_ccRCC.rds")
mse_2_fil_ccRCC <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224_ccRCC.rds")

# Make pData comparable for later merging
mse_1_fil_ccRCC$object_id_1 <- NULL
mse_2_fil_ccRCC$object_id_final <- NULL
mse_2_fil_ccRCC$check_1 <- NULL
mse_2_fil_ccRCC$x_y <- NULL 
```

```{r}
# TMA20
mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20 <- mse_1_fil_ccRCC |> 
  Cardinal::normalize(method="rms") |> 
  smooth() |> 
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 2)

mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20, 
                                                tolerance = 5, units = "ppm")

saveRDS(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_picked_SNR20.rds")

mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR15 <- mse_1_fil_ccRCC |> 
  Cardinal::normalize(method="rms") |> 
  smooth() |> 
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 1.5)

mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR15_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR15, 
                                                tolerance = 5, units = "ppm")

saveRDS(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR15_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_picked_SNR15.rds")

# TMA224
mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20 <- mse_2_fil_ccRCC |> 
  Cardinal::normalize(method="rms") |> 
  smooth() |> 
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 2)

mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20, 
                                                tolerance = 5, units = "ppm")

saveRDS(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224_picked_SNR20.rds")

mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR15 <- mse_2_fil_ccRCC |> 
  Cardinal::normalize(method="rms") |> 
  smooth() |> 
  peakPick(method = "filter", SNR = 1.5)

mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR15_aligned <- peakAlign(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR15, 
                                                tolerance = 5, units = "ppm", 
                                                BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = 2))

saveRDS(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR15_aligned, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224_picked_SNR15.rds")
```

```{r}
plot(mse_1_fil_ccRCC, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 30000), xlim = c(100, 200), ylim=c(0,4e+06))
plot(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 30000), xlim = c(100, 200), ylim=c(0,1e+07))

plot(mse_2_fil_ccRCC, i=c(10, 100, 10000, 30000), xlim = c(100, 200), ylim=c(0,4e+06))
```

### Common mz grid 

```{r}
mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM20_picked_SNR20.rds")

mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/new_data/data_analysis/TM224_picked_SNR20.rds")
```

```{r}
# Round mz values to find common grid
mz(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned) <- round(mz(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned), 4)
mz(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned) <- round(mz(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned), 4)

mz_grid <- intersect(mz(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned), mz(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned)) #373 for SNR20

# Subset to common grid
mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned <- subsetFeatures(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned, mz %in% mz_grid)
mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned <- subsetFeatures(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned, mz %in% mz_grid)

# Combine
mse_combined <- cbind(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned, mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned)


pData(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned)


  
colnames(pData(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned))[!colnames(pData(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned)) %in% 
colnames(pData(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned))]

colnames(pData(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned))[!colnames(pData(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned)) %in% 
colnames(pData(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned))]


colnames(pData(mse_1_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned))
[!colnames(pData(mse_2_fil_ccRCC_proc_SNR20_aligned)) %in% c("object_id_final","check_1")]

fData(mse_combined)

# Subset features
mse_combined
```
